evidence: ui-v041 removes v0.4 audience step and legacy v3 teacher preset from private and public share cards.

S2.name: Default share contract
evidence: Default fields: nickname, overall score/rank, subject scores/ranks; graduation year, school and class remain off by default.
Trajectory scope keeps history enabled through the existing v2 contract.
Natural-language 将分享 / 不会分享 summary is rendered for both private and public share composers.
家庭备注、登录账号、家庭成员和安全信息 remain outside share output and are explicitly named as not shared.

S3.name: Card density reduction
evidence: External share keeps one v41-current-coordinate hero surface.
Recent change is reduced to a v41-change-surface with only the comparable-change item visible.
Six-subject and single-subject history presentations use divider rows rather than full card chrome.
Legacy share-comparison dashboard is hidden in v0.4.1 to prevent duplicate oversized history cards.

S4.name: Restrained semantic color
evidence: Current coordinate uses #f2f7f5 light brand green.
Recent change uses #f3f6f8 cool blue-gray.
History uses #f7f7f5 and neutral content uses #fafaf8.
值得留意 uses #fbf7ed pale amber; no red/green good-bad academic judgment was introduced.

S5.name: Timeline state semantics
evidence: v0.4.1 explicitly labels timeline nodes 最新 / 正在查看 / 历史.
Latest uses the light brand-green state; a selected older exam uses neutral surface plus brand outline.
Timeline nodes are reduced to 104-138px desktop, 100-122px mobile and 96-112px at <=380px instead of near-screen-width cards.
Existing horizontal touch scrolling and click behavior are preserved.

S6.name: Card size and responsive density
evidence: Public coordinate hero uses 18px desktop padding, 14px mobile and 12px <=380px.
Section surfaces use 12-14px mobile/desktop padding and medium radius; rows rely on dividers rather than nested card borders.
Mobile six-subject rows are at least 50px and touch targets retain >=44px contracts.
Public shell clips accidental page-level horizontal overflow while timeline itself remains horizontally scrollable.

S7.name: Persona cleanup audit
evidence: Visible 学生/家长 perspective selector is removed because it changed copy rather than permissions/data/task architecture.
Stored student perspective is cleared so the existing trajectory renderer falls back to one common reading baseline.
Deep-dive and six-subject headings are normalized to identity-neutral language: 单科历史、六科变化和可比考试 / 六科变化怎么走.
External teacher-specific presentation labels are normalized and no teacher identity choice is exposed.

S8.name: Weak-network, privacy and regression
evidence: PR #14 changed only checkpoint/version/index/v0.4.1 UI+CSS/tests; no backend/API/KV/auth/share-token files changed.
CSS immediately suppresses persona controls and the transitional large share-comparison section before JS enhancement.
ui-v041 has no subtree:true or documentElement-wide observer; card wait disconnects after 2500ms and public-shell wait after 4000ms.
v041 UI contract covers privacy, semantic color, compact density, three timeline states, <=380px sizing and observer guards.
